$comment: Nuvellum visual direction (machine-readable). Feeds the visual brief, generation prompts and the QA scorer in scripts/visual/. Human-readable companion: docs/VISUAL_ENGINE.md. The website design (v5.1) is out of scope; this governs editorial artwork only.

palette.relationship: Muted, natural palettes chosen for the story, with at most one restrained deep accent (Nuvellum oxblood or a story-appropriate equivalent). No neon, no saturated rainbow gradients.

composition: One strong visual idea with one obvious focal subject.
Intentional negative space (upper third or one side) so headlines and crops breathe.
Clear foreground, midground and background hierarchy.
Keep the focal subject inside the central 60% so 16:9, 4:3 and 1:1 crops all hold.
lighting: Soft, directional, cinematic where it suits the story; restrained contrast; never glossy stock-photo lighting.
tone: Serious international magazine: calm, intelligent, restrained. Illustrative, never sensational.

abstraction.sensitive: conceptual or symbolic only: places, objects, weather, architecture, empty spaces. No depiction of victims, injuries, violence, arrests, bodies, weapons in use, or identifiable people.

sections.World: Places, landscapes, architecture, borders rendered symbolically; maps only if accurate; no flags unless certain and correct.
sections.Business: Objects, infrastructure, markets rendered as graphic still lifes; no fake logos or tickers.
sections.Technology: Devices and systems as clean conceptual forms; no real brand logos, no fake UI text.
sections.Science: Natural phenomena and instruments; accurate, calm, awe without spectacle.
sections.Crime: Always sensitive: empty places, weather, architecture; never scenes of crime, victims or suspects.
sections.Sports: Motion, venue, equipment; no identifiable athletes or team kits/logos.
sections.Film & TV: Cinematic mood, stage and screen metaphors; no likeness of real actors, no fake posters.
sections.Anime: Respectful stylised illustration; never imitate a specific studio's characters.
sections.Gaming: Conceptual worlds and hardware silhouettes; no copyrighted characters or logos.

typography_in_image: None. No letters, numbers, captions, signage or UI text inside the artwork; the page supplies all type.
mark_usage: The Nuvellum wordmark is never drawn into artwork. The page caption 'NUVELLUM · AI-generated editorial illustration' labels AI imagery.
real_people: Never generate a recognisable likeness of a real person. Refer to people through setting, objects or silhouettes without identifying features.
unacceptable: photorealistic depiction of an event that was not photographed
text, lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, flags or maps unless verified accurate
gore, injury, bodies, weapons in use
malformed anatomy, melted objects, obvious AI artifacts
